items.title: LLM Research and Development Initiatives at the National Institute of Informatics
items.summary:
The National Institute of Informatics established the Large Language Model Research and Development Center in April last year. We are leading the llm-jp (LLM Study Group) activities, which have been ongoing since 2023, aiming to build LLMs with high performance on Japanese tasks and enhanced transparency and reliability. This presentation will introduce specific examples, focusing on models we have released so far, including corpus construction for training, training from scratch, tuning and evaluation, and multimodal capabilities.

--

国立情報学研究所では昨年4月に大規模言語モデル研究開発センターを開設し、2023年より継続しているllm-jp(LLM勉強会)の活動を主宰する形で、日本語タスク性能が高く、透明性・信頼性を向上させたLLMの構築を目指して研究開発に取り組んでいます。本講演では、これまでに公開したモデルを中心に、学習コーパス構築、スクラッチからの学習、チューニング・評価、マルチモーダル対応などの具体例を紹介します。

items.title: The One Trick That Makes AI Coding Easier
items.summary:
In episode 947 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jeffrey Li explains why he has shifted from opposing monorepos to supporting them due to AI tools like Cursor. He notes that scattered repositories make it difficult for AI to gather necessary context, whereas a monolithic repository allows the agent to easily find relevant files. This structure enables the AI to reference specific folders and generate accurate Python scripts more efficiently.

Additional materials: https://www.superdatascience.com/947

items.title: Building Ambient AI Medical Scribes: Best Practices
items.summary:
🚀 Guide to Building Ambient AI Scribes: https://www.assemblyai.com/ambient-ai-scribes-guide?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=tutorials&utm_content=mart_ambient_scribe 

Learn how to build a simple AI ambient medical scribe in Python using AssemblyAI. 

In this tutorial, we start with a basic transcription request in under 30 lines of code and incrementally add features that matter in real clinical workflows. You’ll see how to improve medical transcription accuracy with key terms, label speakers by role (doctor vs. patient), generate SOAP notes using LLMs, and apply PII redaction to protect patient privacy. 

We’ll also cover how to delete transcription and LLM data after processing so your application meets strict data retention and privacy requirements. By the end, you’ll have a practical foundation for building a production-ready ambient medical scribe.

01:01 – Speaker identification (doctor vs. patient)

Evolving Large Language Model Evaluation: Practices and Insights from the Swallow Project
items.summary:
In the research and development of large language models (LLMs), evaluation is essential for accurately understanding their capabilities and limitations. With the recent advancements in LLMs, their evaluation benchmarks and methods also require updates. This presentation will organize evaluation challenges and the latest trends from multifaceted perspectives, including knowledge, reasoning, multilingual support, increasing difficulty, and LLM agents. Furthermore, as an evaluation practice in Japanese LLM development, we will introduce the evaluation frameworks swallow-evaluation and swallow-evaluation-instruct developed within the Swallow Project. 

--

大規模言語モデル（LLM）の研究開発では、その性能や限界を適切に把握する評価が欠かせません。近年のLLMの発展に伴い、LLMの評価ベンチマークや評価方法もアップデートが必要になっています。本講演では、知識、推論、多言語対応、高難易度化、LLMエージェントといった多面的観点から、評価の課題と最新動向を整理します。また、日本語LLM開発における評価の実践として、Swallowプロジェクトで開発した評価フレームワークswallow-evaluationおよびswallow-evaluation-instructを紹介します。

items.title: The Hidden Skill Boost Behind Posting Online
items.summary:
Sharing content online is one of the highest-ROI habits you can build, and it has nothing to do with going viral.

When I started, my goal wasn’t audience or money. It was learning. Content forces clarity. Saying “I want to learn MPC” is vague. But saying “I’m going to write a post explaining MPC and build a custom server” is direction. It gives you a target, a deadline, and a feedback loop. You learn 10x faster because you have to teach it back.

And the best part? Even if nobody reads it, you still win. You walk away with skills, understanding, and a sharper mind. Content is just the tool that makes the learning concrete.

I’m Louis-François, PhD dropout, now CTO and co-founder at Towards AI. Follow me for tomorrow’s no BS AI roundup 🚀

#contentcreation #learninginpublic #buildinpublic
